Welcome to the official YouTube channel of TOLFA (Tree of Life for Animals), a charitable trust founded in 2005 with a vision of a world where animals live free from injury and diseases and are valued as our equals. Our channel is dedicated to bringing you heartwarming rescue stories, animal welfare awareness content, and regular updates on the activities at our shelter and hospital.

With over 60 dedicated staff members and over 400 animals in our care at any time, we have come a long way from a makeshift clinic to a big veterinary hospital spread across 4 bigha of land situated in the foothills of Aravali ranges near Pushkar.

Join us in our mission to provide vital and preventative healthcare to India's ownerless animals and help us create a world where animals and people live together in harmony. Don't forget to subscribe to our channel and hit the notification bell to stay updated on our latest content. Thank you for your support!
